{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the data
print("Shape:", df.shape)
print("\nColumns:", df.columns.tolist())
print("\nFirst few rows:\n", df.head(3))

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("\nUnique values in customer_age:", df['customer_age'].unique())
print("Count of -1 in customer_age:", (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check revenue format
print("\nSample of revenue:", df['revenue'].head())

# Check status
print("\nStatus value counts:\n", df['status'].value_counts())

# Check converted
print("\nConverted value counts:\n", df['converted'].value_counts())"}
